body.statement: SPEC-10.2-13: Each capsule is the engine's (§8) with three members taken from the same report: `closures` on a duty, every closure attempt with its verdict and why; `closes` on a transition, each item with its duty, the duty's statement and disposition, the verdict and why; and `reading`, one line over those fields.
